name: ThemeSmarter Power Pack for Storefront
author: ThemeSmarter

sections.description:
ThemeSmarter Power Pack for Storefront is a WordPress plugin that adds advanced customization options to the Storefront theme for WooCommerce. It allows store owners to improve layout, product presentation, and overall usability using native WordPress tools.

Built specifically for the Storefront theme, this plugin focuses on simplicity, performance, and compatibility. All settings are integrated into the WordPress Customizer, making it easy to preview changes in real time without touching code.

Whether you are launching a new WooCommerce store or refining an existing one, ThemeSmarter Power Pack for Storefront helps you gain more control over your store’s appearance while keeping a clean and lightweight setup.

Key Features

  • Advanced product card styles
  • Custom footer menu support
  • Layout width control
  • Footer text customization with automatic year
  • Native WordPress Customizer integration
  • Lightweight and performance-focused
  • Built specifically for the Storefront theme

Built to Grow

ThemeSmarter Power Pack for Storefront is designed with scalability in mind. The core plugin provides essential customization features, while future enhancements will expand functionality for more advanced store needs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the WordPress Customizer to access the available customization options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any theme?

No. ThemeSmarter Power Pack for Storefront is built specifically for the Storefront theme.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with WooCommerce stores using the Storefront theme.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No. All options are available through the WordPress Customizer.

Will this plugin affect performance?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized to avoid unnecessary overhead.
